scripts.render: bun run music && bun run render:landscape && bun run render:square && bun run render:gif
scripts.render:landscape: remotion render src/index.ts PromoLandscape out/promo-landscape.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:square: remotion render src/index.ts PromoSquare out/promo-square.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:gif: remotion render src/index.ts PromoLoop out/promo-loop.gif --codec gif --scale 0.6667 --every-nth-frame 2
